text:
Boosting a post is not the same as running ads.

A cafe in Anna Nagar boosts a nice reel. It gets likes, a few new followers, and zero table bookings.

Because the boost was set up for reach, not enquiries.

So before you spend more, ask one thing: what should someone do right after seeing this ad? Call? Message? Book?

If you can't answer that, your ad can't either.

Book a free consultation (link in the reply).
headline: Likes don't pay rent. Enquiries do.
linkedin_hook: Most business owners don't have a content problem. They have a time problem.

text:
Your website gets visitors. So why is nobody enquiring?

Most of the time it's not the design. It's the first screen.

A clinic in Velachery doesn't need a fancy slider. It needs:
→ what you do, in one line
→ where you are
→ one clear button: Book an appointment

If a visitor has to scroll just to figure out what to do next, they leave.

Want a website that actually brings enquiries? Book a free consultation (link in the reply).
headline: Visitors but no enquiries? Fix the first screen.
linkedin_hook: One shoot day can give you a month of reels. But only if you plan it before the camera comes out.
